passages.title: Text 01
passages.text: Hi Rina, The dance class starts at 3 p.m. Please come at 2:45 to change your shoes. — Ms Ayu

passages.title: Text 02
passages.text: Café menu: Orange juice — Rp8,000. Milk — Rp6,000. Water — Rp3,000.

passages.title: Text 03
passages.text: Hello, Ben. I left your green notebook in the kitchen. Your blue notebook is on the sofa. — Dad

passages.title: Text 04
passages.text: Sports Day: Grade 4 runs at 9 a.m. Grade 5 runs at 10 a.m. Everyone meets at the field.

passages.title: Text 05
passages.text: My sister Hana likes painting. On Saturdays, she paints flowers with her friend Nita.

passages.title: Text 06
passages.text: LIBRARY NOTICE: The library closes at 4 p.m. on Monday and at 2 p.m. on Friday. Please return books before closing.

passages.title: Text 07
passages.text: Hi Tio, I cannot meet you on Tuesday because I have a dentist appointment. Wednesday after school is fine. — Farah

passages.title: Text 08
passages.text: Bus timetable: Bus 1 goes to the market at 7:15. Bus 2 goes to the station at 7:30. Bus 3 goes to the market at 8:00.

passages.title: Text 09
passages.text: Dear students, Bring your colored pencils for art on Thursday. You do not need to bring paint. — Mr Rio

passages.title: Text 10
passages.text: Maya buys bread for Rp5,000 and a banana for Rp3,000. She does not buy the Rp4,000 cake.

passages.title: Text 11
passages.text: After school, Arman takes his sister home. Then he goes to football practice at the park.

passages.title: Text 12
passages.text: School trip groups: Group Red visits the museum in the morning and the garden in the afternoon. Group Blue visits the garden in the morning and the museum in the afternoon.

passages.title: Text 13
passages.text: Hi Yuni, The science room is being cleaned today. Our science club will meet in Room 6 instead. We still start at 3 p.m. — Mr Dika

passages.title: Text 14
passages.text: Niko has a yellow raincoat and a black jacket. It is raining, so he wears the raincoat to school.

passages.title: Text 15
passages.text: Message from Aunt Sita: I will arrive on Saturday morning. Please meet me at the train station, not the bus stop. My train arrives at 9:20.

passages.title: Text 16
passages.text: Book club plan: On Monday, Deni borrows a book from the library. On Wednesday, he reads it with Lina. On Friday, they return it together.

passages.title: Text 17
passages.text: School announcement: The playground is closed this morning because workers are fixing the gate. Students may play there after lunch, but the basketball court is closed all day.

passages.title: Text 18
passages.text: Hi Fira, I put your project in the office because your classroom was locked. Ask Ms Lani for it before the lesson starts at 8:30. — Bima

passages.title: Text 19
passages.text: Market trip: Seno needs eggs and rice. The egg shop opens at 8 a.m., but the rice shop opens at 9 a.m. Seno arrives at 8:30.

passages.title: Text 20
passages.text: Trip reminder: Bring your lunch and a bottle of water. Meet at the school gate by 7:15 a.m. The bus leaves at 7:30 a.m.

questions.prompt: What time should Rina come?
questions.evidence: Please come at 2:45 to change your shoes.
questions.explanation: Rina diminta datang pukul 2.45, sebelum kelas mulai pukul 3.

questions.prompt: How much is the milk?
questions.evidence: Milk — Rp6,000.
questions.explanation: Harga susu adalah Rp6.000.

questions.prompt: Where is Ben's green notebook?
questions.evidence: I left your green notebook in the kitchen. Your blue notebook is on the sofa.
questions.explanation: Buku catatan hijau ada di dapur; yang biru ada di sofa.

questions.prompt: When does Grade 5 run?
questions.evidence: Grade 4 runs at 9 a.m. Grade 5 runs at 10 a.m.
questions.explanation: Kelas 5 berlari pukul 10, sedangkan kelas 4 pukul 9.

questions.prompt: Who paints with Hana?
questions.evidence: On Saturdays, she paints flowers with her friend Nita.
questions.explanation: Hana melukis bersama temannya, Nita.

questions.prompt: When does the library close on Friday?
questions.evidence: The library closes at 4 p.m. on Monday and at 2 p.m. on Friday.
questions.explanation: Hari Jumat perpustakaan tutup pukul 2 siang, bukan pukul 4 seperti hari Senin.

questions.prompt: When can Farah meet Tio?
questions.evidence: I cannot meet you on Tuesday because I have a dentist appointment. Wednesday after school is fine.
questions.explanation: Farah tidak bisa Selasa dan bisa bertemu Rabu setelah sekolah.

questions.prompt: Which bus goes to the station, and when?
questions.evidence: Bus 2 goes to the station at 7:30.
questions.explanation: Bus 2 menuju stasiun pukul 7.30; bus lainnya menuju pasar.

questions.prompt: What should students bring on Thursday?
questions.evidence: Bring your colored pencils for art on Thursday. You do not need to bring paint.
questions.explanation: Siswa perlu membawa pensil warna, bukan cat.

questions.prompt: Which two things does Maya buy?
questions.evidence: Maya buys bread for Rp5,000 and a banana for Rp3,000. She does not buy the Rp4,000 cake.
questions.explanation: Maya membeli roti dan pisang. Teks menyebut bahwa ia tidak membeli kue.

questions.prompt: Where does Arman go after taking his sister home?
questions.evidence: Then he goes to football practice at the park.
questions.explanation: Setelah mengantar saudara perempuannya pulang, Arman pergi latihan sepak bola di taman.

questions.prompt: Where is Group Blue in the morning?
questions.evidence: Group Blue visits the garden in the morning and the museum in the afternoon.
questions.explanation: Kelompok Biru ke taman pada pagi hari, lalu ke museum pada siang/sore hari.

questions.prompt: Where and when will the science club meet?
questions.evidence: Our science club will meet in Room 6 instead. We still start at 3 p.m.
questions.explanation: Tempatnya pindah ke Ruang 6, tetapi waktunya tetap pukul 3.

questions.prompt: What does Niko wear to school?
questions.evidence: Niko has a yellow raincoat and a black jacket. It is raining, so he wears the raincoat to school.
questions.explanation: Karena hujan, Niko memakai jas hujan kuning, bukan jaket hitam.

questions.prompt: Where should the family meet Aunt Sita?
questions.evidence: Please meet me at the train station, not the bus stop.
questions.explanation: Bibi Sita meminta dijemput di stasiun kereta, bukan halte bus.

questions.prompt: What do Deni and Lina do on Friday?
questions.evidence: On Friday, they return it together.
questions.explanation: Hari Jumat mereka mengembalikan buku bersama; meminjam dan membaca terjadi pada hari lain.

questions.prompt: Where can students play after lunch?
questions.evidence: School announcement: The playground is closed this morning because workers are fixing the gate. Students may play there after lunch, but the basketball court is closed all day.
questions.explanation: Lapangan bermain bisa digunakan setelah makan siang, tetapi lapangan basket tutup sepanjang hari.

questions.prompt: Where should Fira go, and who should she ask?
choices: To the classroom; ask Ms Lani
To the office; ask Ms Lani
To the library; ask Ms Lani
questions.evidence: I put your project in the office because your classroom was locked. Ask Ms Lani for it before the lesson starts at 8:30.
questions.explanation: Proyek ada di kantor dan Fira harus memintanya kepada Bu Lani.

questions.prompt: What can Seno buy when he arrives?
questions.evidence: The egg shop opens at 8 a.m., but the rice shop opens at 9 a.m. Seno arrives at 8:30.
questions.explanation: Pukul 8.30 toko telur sudah buka, sedangkan toko beras baru buka pukul 9.

questions.prompt: What should students bring, and when must they meet?
questions.evidence: Bring your lunch and a bottle of water. Meet at the school gate by 7:15 a.m. The bus leaves at 7:30 a.m.
questions.explanation: Siswa harus membawa bekal dan air minum serta berkumpul paling lambat pukul 7.15; pukul 7.30 adalah waktu bus berangkat.
